title: Cursor team panel
description: One full-width paper panel: a short 22px statement about the team in ink and an orange 'join us' link in a narrow, vertically centred column, beside a wide 1.6:1 photo frame inset 17px from the panel's edges. On phones the text comes first and a 16:9 photo below.
notes: the empty photo slot is a flat muted panel
